property_summary: SetLogFile reverts when initialized is false in the reference, but succeeds in the modified version, so after Initialized() is called, SetLogFile reverts in the reference (because initialized is true) but also reverts in the modified version (because initialized is true and condition is !initialized). Actually, the divergence is before Initialized: the reference allows SetLogFile when initialized is false, but the modified version reverts. So the concrete scenario: call SetLogFile before Initialized, which succeeds in reference but reverts in modified. Then assert that the Log address was set in reference but not in modified.
